## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm check` passes (types, lint, format, leads:check, tests)
- [ ] UI strings are in `src/i18n/en.ts`
- [ ] Saved data changes come with a `version` bump and a `migrate` step in `src/store.ts`
- [ ] Nothing new leaves the machine: no network requests, CDNs, telemetry or hosting config
- [ ] Screenshots, if any, are from `pnpm demo`
